title: Payments Misdirected during the Promotional Window: Crestline Credit Card Deferred-Interest Reallocation
content:
On the Crestline Credit Card, the window reallocation applies the rule that, during a deferred-interest plan's last 2 billing cycles, the amount paid above the minimum goes to that plan first: an allocation recorded for a payment made toward the statement of the plan's last recorded accrual that went instead to another deferred-interest plan whose period ends after this plan's period is misdirected, and the allocation of the most recent returned payment is left out of the misdirected total; when misdirected allocations exist and no other deferred-interest plan's period ended after that statement closed and before this plan's period ended, their total is reallocated to this plan and taken off its balance left, never more than its recorded balance; when such other plans' periods did end in between, only the part of that total beyond those plans' recorded balances is reallocated, again never more than this plan's recorded balance; otherwise nothing is reallocated.

Because the misdirected amount should have reduced this plan from the day it was allocated, interest on the reallocated amount at the daily rate is taken off for each day from the date of the latest allocation recorded toward that statement to such a later-ending plan through the last day of the period, and nothing is taken off when that date falls after the last day of the period. The interest taken off reduces the deferred interest Northgate assesses on the plan.

## Terms

- **Recorded balance** (of this plan or another): purchase amount less the payment allocations recorded for it and less the merchandise credits that carry its ticket number.
- **Daily rate:** the account's purchase rate divided by 365.
- **Days counted:** from the latest misdirected allocation date through the last day of the period, both days counted.

## Decision table

| Misdirected allocations toward the last accrual's statement | Other deferred plans whose period ended between that statement's closing and this plan's end | Reallocated amount |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | nothing |
| some | none | their total, never more than this plan's recorded balance |
| some | one or more | the part of their total beyond those plans' recorded balances, never more than this plan's recorded balance |

## Cases (hypothetical, daily rate a round 0.1 percent from a 36.5 percent purchase rate)

A 6-month plan's last accrual is on the statement closing 10 June and its period ends 14 June; its recorded balance is 400.00 USD. A payment made toward the 10 June statement had 150.00 USD allocated on 12 June to an 18-month plan ending the following year.

- No other plan ended between 10 and 14 June: 150.00 USD is reallocated; interest for 12 to 14 June, 3 days, 0.45 USD, is taken off.
- A 12-month plan with a recorded balance of 100.00 USD ended 13 June: only 50.00 USD is reallocated; 0.15 USD is taken off.
- The recorded balance of this plan is 120.00 USD and no other plan ended in between: 120.00 USD is reallocated; 0.36 USD is taken off.
- The 150.00 USD came from the most recent returned payment: it is left out; nothing is reallocated.
